results: The chairs always have equal energy

missions.q: Can cis-1,2-dimethylcyclohexane have a chair with both methyl groups equatorial?
results: No: one is axial and one equatorial in either chair

missions.q: Which 1,3-dimethyl stereoisomer can adopt a diequatorial chair?
